messages:
ana: Quick design check — on small phones the console sidebar is taking too much real estate and table rows are overflowing on 360–412px widths. Anyone seen complaints from support?

mike: Yup, support flagged it yesterday. They said filter panel + full nav = horizontal scroll.

sam: I put together a quick proto: collapse to icons-only at <=420px, move filters into top overflow menu. Screenshot in #design-updates.

ana: (typo) ana: Nice — icons-only could work if we keep labels on hover/tap. Accessibility note: touch targets need to stay >=44px.

julia: Agree on touch size. Also need aria-expanded and focus trap for the collapsed sidebar so keyboard users aren't lost.

mike: Thinking breakpoint set: 480px for full collapse, 768 for tablet stack. Quick CSS snippet: ```css
@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .sidebar { width: 56px; }
  .main-panel { padding-left: 64px; }
}
```

sam: Table strategy — prefer truncate w/ ellipsis + row expand or tooltip. Wrapping rows kill virtualization perf on low-end devices. For ids/paths show full value in a secondary panel on tap.

ana: Copy nit: 'Columns' is long — on mobile use 'Fields' or just an icon label. 'Expand' vs 'Details' wording also inconsistent.

julia: I'll PR copy tweaks. Also adding a mobile-a11y checklist to the spec (contrast, touch targets, focus order).

mike: One more micro-nit — hamburger icon contrast fails AA when placed over the gradient header. Either add a subtle outline or use a 700-weight icon.

sam: I'll run axe on the staging preview. Devex, can we get a preview URL?

devex-bot: Preview deployed: https://staging.redwood.dev/console/mobile-proto-428 — creds: mobile/test. Tagging @eng-frontend for perf on low-end android.

ana: Thanks — can someone also test swipe-to-open gesture? On Android it sometimes conflicts with horizontal table scroll.

mike: Suggestion: disable swipe-to-open when table scroll is active, and allow long-press on icons for quick actions.

julia: Good compromise. I'll update the spec with: icons-only sidebar, aria-expanded, tooltip on long tap, filters moved to header overflow, breakpoint at 480 and 768, min touch 44px, tooltip & row-expand for truncated cells.

sam: I'll follow up with perf numbers and a short list of problematic pages (embeddings, model-runs table).

ana: Great — thanks everyone. Small follow-up: please add the copy diff to the PR description so PMs can sign off quickly. :thumbsup:

devex-bot: e2e tag added: @eng-frontend please triage.
